GATE 3 IS MET AT 114/114 - the last outstanding fixture requirement does not exist. parenthesized_list_splat can only be produced by source CPython 3.10.4 REJECTS. Verified against the interpreter: 't = ((*a))', 't = ((*a),)', 'f((*a))', 'x = [(*a)]', 'x = {(*a)}' are all SyntaxError; the only tree-sitter form that yields the un-aliased node is 't = ((*a))'. In every other position the grammar ALIASES it to parenthesized_expression. It therefore belongs in the deduction set alongside member_type and splat_type, not in the fixture gap. Corrected ceiling 115 -> 114. A2 does NOT need to write anything further for Gate 3.
